subject.title: feat(ios): unify chat and voice experience

question: Should iOS adopt Chat as the sole conversational destination and remove the separate Talk tab while retaining realtime voice as a Chat action?
rationale: This intentionally changes a primary mobile navigation and interaction model, and both the PR and canonical issue carry the protected maintainer signal requiring explicit product ownership.

options.title: Adopt unified Chat
options.body: Approve the single-destination model after the localization churn is removed, documentation is aligned, and refreshed iOS proof passes.

options.title: Keep separate Talk
options.body: Retain Talk as a primary destination and narrow this branch to session, audio, attachment, and Live Activity ownership fixes.

options.title: Pause the redesign
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open but close or substantially rework this broad branch if maintainers do not want to choose the navigation direction now.

recommendation.title: Adopt unified Chat
recommendation.body: Approve the single-destination model after the localization churn is removed, documentation is aligned, and refreshed iOS proof passes.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository history and contributor routing most directly associate this person with the iOS app surface and its product/security boundary.
